reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 17% of expected)
Category III share of certificates is 52%, +50% versus what its process route can produce
Uploaded plant photos are near-duplicates of photos registered by 1 other plant(s)
Claimed tonnage in the busiest month would need 168% of the plant's connected load running non-stop (above 100% is physically impossible)
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.49x the cost floor)
59% of certificate tonnes were generated more than 45 days after the processing month

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
Obtain the DISCOM consumption statement and meter readings for the flagged months; compare connected machinery (kW) against the claimed tonnage.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
